title: Two City Scheduling
summary: Given an array of costs for flying each of the 2n people to either city A or city B, determine the lowest total cost to ensure that exactly n people are flown to each city.
statement: Given an array of costs for flying each of the 2n people to either city A or city B, determine the lowest total cost to ensure that exactly n people are flown to each city.
constraints: There are 2n people and each row gives costs to cities A and B.
Send exactly n people to each city at minimum cost.
hints: Start with everyone assigned conceptually, then compare relative savings.
Sort by costA-costB and send the first n to A.
Sum A costs for the first half and B costs for the rest.
Any inversion in difference can be swapped to no greater cost, proving the sorted split.
editorial: Any inversion in difference can be swapped to no greater cost, proving the sorted split.

tests.explanation: Assign people one and four to A and the others to B for total 110.
